svg.text: Each A/B interleaved its two builds run by run, each build's own binary: release against release-thin (10 pairs, Oct 2 01:13,
load 15 to 20), then glibc against static musl (8 pairs, 08:31, load 8 to 16 and the machine filling, so both builds' times rise
run by run). Compare within an A/B, not across.
